item.title: Fauvism can be seen as an extreme extension of the post-impressionism of Van Gogh combined with the neo-impressionism of...
item.author: house.of.arts.ensias
item.content:encoded: Fauvism can be seen as an extreme extension of the post-impressionism of Van Gogh combined with the neo-impressionism of Seurat. The influences of these earlier movements inspired Matisse and his followers to reject traditional three-dimensional space and instead use flat areas or patches of colour to create a new pictorial space. Fauvism can also be seen as a form of expressionism in its use of brilliant colors and spontaneous brushwork. It has often been compared to German expressionism, which emerged at around the same time and was also inspired by the developments of post-impressionism. Although one of the first avant-garde modernist movements of the twentieth century and one of the first styles to make a move towards abstraction, for many of the artists who adopted a fauvist approach it became a transitional stepping stone for future developments in their style. By 1908 most of the main artists in the group had moved away from the expressive emotionalism of fauvism. A renewed interest in post-impressionist artist Paul Cézanne and the analytical approach he took to painting landscapes, people and objects inspired many artists to embrace order and structure instead. One–time fauvist Georges Braque went on to develop cubism along with Pablo Picasso while one of fauvism’s founders André Derain adopted a more conventional neoclassical style. Henri Matisse however continued to use the distinctive fauvist traits of bright emotive colours, simple shapes and painterly mark-making throughout his career. Credits to: Tate & ArtDaily magazine. #Art #Fauvism #HOA #HouseOfArts #Paintings

item.title: Did you know humanoid robots now have their own Olympic-level games? ...
item.author: ensias_neurodynamics_club
item.content:encoded: Did you know humanoid robots now have their own Olympic-level games? The Robolympics (World Humanoid Robot Games) in Beijing just put autonomous AI to the ultimate test. Here is a quick breakdown of what went down inside the Ice Ribbon: Massive Scale: 2,056 humanoid robots across 666 teams representing 16 countries. 51 Diverse Events: From track & field, boxing, and gymnastics to practical real-world challenges like warehouse sorting, firefighting, and picking beans. Blazing Speed: The fastest 100m sprint recorded hit 8.64 seconds—for comparison, Usain Bolt’s legendary record stands at 9.58s! It wasn't all smooth sailing, though. Robots fell apart, crashed, slipped, and failed to finish. While the technology isn't completely replacing humans yet, it is evolving at a breakneck pace. Swipe through the carousel to see how close we are to a future powered by embodied AI! ➡️ #Robolympics #HumanoidRobots #EmbodiedAI #Robotics #ArtificialIntelligence #TechTrends #BeijingIceRibbon #FutureTech #Innovation #AI #TechNews #RoboticsEngineering

item.title: PSA: With agora by night around the corner, it’s time to discover that your trusty deck of cards is basically a...
item.author: house.of.arts.ensias
item.content:encoded: PSA: With agora by night around the corner, it’s time to discover that your trusty deck of cards is basically a 500-ish year-old art project disguised as entertainment. Also! Keep in mind that these cards were never intended as historical portraits. French card makers in the 1500s just took their generic king designs and slapped famous names on them for marketing/entertainment value. They were projecting their own medieval worldview onto ancient history ,Alexander became a “king” in the European feudal sense, even though he was actually a Hellenistic emperor. It’s like if someone in 2000 years said “the King of Clubs represents George Washington” ,future card makers might draw him in 21st-century business attire, not colonial-era clothes. The representation tells you more about who was drawing the card than who it supposedly represents. #Art #HOA #HouseOfArts #cards #history

item.title: هل تساءلت يوماً: كيف بدأ الاحتفال بالمولد النبوي؟ ومن أول من أحدث...
item.author: clubquran_ensias
item.content:encoded: هل تساءلت يوماً: كيف بدأ الاحتفال بالمولد النبوي؟ ومن أول من أحدث هذه العادة في التاريخ الإسلامي؟ في هذا المنشور، نأخذكم في رحلة تاريخية وشرعية للغوص في جذور هذه المسألة. نكشف لكم كيف وظّفت "الدولة العبيدية" (التي سُميت زوراً بالفاطمية) العاطفة الدينية واستغلت محبة المسلمين للنبي ﷺ لغايات وأجندات سياسية بحتة، وذلك بعد 300 سنة من وفاته ﷺ وانقضاء القرون المفضلة. مرر الشاشة لتعرف القصة الكاملة، مدعمة بالأدلة القاطعة من القرآن الكريم والسنة النبوية، وموثقة من أمهات كتب التاريخ. أبرز المصادر التاريخية والشرعية المعتمدة: كتاب "المواعظ والاعتبار بذكر الخطط والآثار" للإمام المقريزي. كتاب "صبح الأعشى في صناعة الإنشا" للمؤرخ القلقشندي. كتاب "المورد في عمل المولد" للإمام تاج الدين الفاكهاني.

item.title: ليس الأثر بقيمة ما نقدم، بل بجمال ما نتركه في حياة الآخرين....
item.author: cindh_ensias
item.content:encoded: ليس الأثر بقيمة ما نقدم، بل بجمال ما نتركه في حياة الآخرين. ﴿وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْيَتَامَىٰ ۖ قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ﴾ [البقرة: 220]، وقد أوصانا الله ورسوله بالإحسان إلى اليتيم؛ فمن أبسط صور الإحسان مسح رأسه، فكيف إذا اقترن ذلك بتقديم دروس الدعم والمرافقة المعنوية له ليخطو خطى ثابتة نحو مستقبله ؟ وللعطاء مواسم كالعيد؛ فأضحية تدخل السرور على أسرة تكابد مرارة الحياة، وتخفف عن أم مثقلة الكاهل، تواجه وحدها قسوة الظروف لتضمن العيش الكريم لأيتامها. ولا يقل عن ذلك أهمية سقيا الماء، امتثالا لقوله تعالى: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ﴾ [الأنبياء: 30]، بحفر الآبار. فجزى الله خيرا كل يد للعطاء امتدت، وكل قلب بإسعاد غيره ارتضى. #more_than_just_family #صناعة_الأثر
